name: maybe_Container_HashMap_FindByNameA
summary: Type-checked lookup in the global named-object registry: hashes the key, walks the bucket list, keeps objects whose vtable type id equals the UI-scene-flow class, and compares the 0x40-byte key; returns the match or 0.
evidence: Same body as 0x007139AC apart from the type-id constant; hash bucket walk plus 0x40-byte key compare via 0x00123660 is clear, but the registry's owner/class is not proven.

name: maybe_Container_HashMap_FindByNameB
summary: Twin of 0x007135D4 with the model-class type id: hashed registry lookup returning the object whose 0x40-byte key matches, or 0.
evidence: Identical body to 0x007135D4 except the type-id constant; caller Model_LoadHitEffectResources fits a model registry, but the key contract is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_std_AllocRuntimeBlock
summary: Allocates a 0x88-byte block via Mem_Alloc and zeroes its first byte; the terminate-state holder stores the result at +0x1C.
evidence: Mem_Alloc callee is certain and the 0x88 size is in the disassembly, but the C++ type behind the block is not recoverable.

name: maybe_std_ThrowWideRange2
signature: void maybe_std_ThrowWideRange2(const u16* msg, u32 len)
summary: Wide-character range throw helper: builds a two-byte-stride range over the message, formats through std_vprintf_flags1, and returns 0xFFFFFFFF when the formatted length exceeds len.
evidence: Same body as the other range/fixed throw helpers apart from the literal; only the shared body supports the name.

name: maybe_Os_IpcSendResultState
summary: Calls Os_IpcSendByteLocked and normalises its Result to 1 (non-negative) or 2 (negative).
evidence: Body is exactly the locked send plus (result>>31)+1; no callers, so the owner and meaning of 1/2 are unproven.

name: maybe_Fs_SetTransferPriority
summary: Enables/disables the twelve transfer channels at self+0x20..+0x50 using the 5-bytes-per-mode table at 0x0072D710, and at mode 4 arms or cancels the bulk transfer.
evidence: Only in-engine caller is Fs_CacheSet_Initialize; the channel table and per-mode enable loop are visible but no priority semantics are named.

name: maybe_Os_InitTimeoutBase
summary: One-time init of the global timing record at 0x007AEA48: stores 10x the tick period at +0x18, sets the time-source byte at +1, and marks the record usable at +0.
evidence: 64-bit x10 store and two readiness bytes confirmed in asm; only caller is Gfx_InitDefaultTexture, but 0x0010BE98/0x0010BE20 have no readable body.

name: maybe_Os_GetLockDepth
summary: Asserts bit 0 of the global lock object's +4 word and returns the object's first word.
evidence: Caller 0x00104FDC uses the return as a runtime-flag byte; reading a counter from the global lock object is confirmed, but 'depth' is a guess.

name: maybe_Os_ShutdownSyncObject
summary: Tears down a global sync/service object: closes registered handles, unlinks the list node, issues svcCloseHandle and clears the state word under an exclusive-access lock.
evidence: Body closes handles via svc 0x23, unlinks 0x007E79D8, clears state under lock at 0x007AEA10; only caller Input_Initialize does not clearly reference this entry, object identity unknown.

name: Gfx_SetFrameReadyFlag
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetFrameReadyFlag(GfxDisplay* self, FrameRecord* rec, u8 value)
summary: Stores a value in the frame record's +0x11 byte and, when the display state is 0x300, takes the GPU lock, executes the command list and releases it.
evidence: Named callee Gfx_ExecuteCommandList and caller Gfx_Display_Initialize place it in frame submission; +0x11 'ready' meaning still inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_SubmitValueCommand
summary: Stores a value at record+0x10 and submits it with command header 0x0B0501C8 through Gfx_IpcCmd861.
evidence: Only a store plus GPU command submission; no callers and no channel index, so the command's meaning is unproven.

name: Gfx_SetFrameTimeBudget
summary: Stores a frame interval into the global frame-timing record at 0x007F2644, recomputes the derived 1000/tick value and optionally copies five timing words out.
evidence: Record 0x007F2644 is also read by named Gfx_OpenGpuChannel; callers Gfx_InitializeCommandBuffers and Gfx_SetDisplayMode support frame-timing role, but field meanings unproven.

name: maybe_Snd_StopVoiceGroup
summary: Stops and resets one voice group: releases the stream context, invalidates four channel ids and clears the active byte.
evidence: Body unchanged; four -1 channel ids fit one stream's voices, but no caller exists so 'voice group' remains a struct label.

name: maybe_Snd_GetCommandBlock
summary: Thunk that forwards to the command-block getter 0x001129F4 and returns its result.
evidence: Body returns callee result (Ghidra dropped the return type); 0x001129F4 is the command-block getter used by 0x00112848/0x00112888; no caller.

name: maybe_Save_CompleteAsyncRead
summary: Completes an asynchronous save/load request by passing five request fields to Save_AsyncReadWorker and storing completion state 5 in the shared work object.
evidence: Named callee Save_AsyncReadWorker and shared completion state 0x007B00E0 support the hand-off, but no readable caller confirms the completion role.

name: maybe_Os_HandleInit
summary: Creates a kernel handle into an empty out slot via 0x0012038C and aborts on failure; aborts with 0xE0A0183B if the slot is already set, so it is a create-once helper.
evidence: Initial result 0xE0A0183B with bit 31 set is an invalid-state assert; callers (Os_IsInHeapRange, Os_VirtualToPhysical, OS helpers) only need a fresh handle slot, kind unknown.

name: maybe_Hid_GetEventObject
signature: u32 maybe_Hid_GetEventObject(HidObject* object, u32* out, u32 defaultValue, u32 b)
summary: Writes the default into *out, then if the object has a session handle at +8 sends command 0x0C through Svc_IpcCmdC0040 which overwrites *out; always returns 0xC8A0A7F8.
evidence: Only caller of Svc_IpcCmdC0040 (cmd 0x0C); Hid_ owner is inference only; constant return carries no info.

name: maybe_Os_StoreThreadLocalValue
summary: Allocator shim that passes the per-thread block, the global process handle and two arguments to the command-0x08 IPC helper.
evidence: Callee is command-0x08 IPC request 0x0011F65C; caller is Mem_CommitAllocation; meaning of value unknown.

name: maybe_Os_DestroyThreadLocal
summary: At thread exit fetches the thread-local object and destroys it via 0x0011F730 followed by Gfx_IpcCmd1A0000.
evidence: Reached from Gfx_IpcCmd50100; callees unnamed; TLS shape only.

name: maybe_Snd_SetMasterEnable
summary: Switches global output on/off: enable arms the stream via Os_InvokeCallbacks, disable stops it via maybe_Snd_FlushChannelsOnStop, then updates the flag byte at 0x007AE910+4.
evidence: Arms/stops stream and updates flag byte; owner inferred from flag, not a named service.

name: maybe_Os_WaitSharedBlock
summary: Waits on the handle in *state with svcWaitSynchronization1, asserts on negative result, then re-opens the SDK session.
evidence: No callers; svc 0x24 wait plus Os_EnsureIpcSessionOpen confirm sync/session shape but target unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_SetTextureFill
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetTextureFill(u32 src, u32 size, int enable, u32 color)
summary: Queues PICA200 surface commands on the GPU message queue: optionally a type-5 record with source/size, then a type-1 record with the fill colour.
evidence: Sits in Gfx_SetTexture* family pushing records to 0x007B0070 queue; 'fill' rests on record types and colour word.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelMode
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelMode(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, int mode, unsigned char priority)
summary: Sets a channel's play mode byte at +0xE and, when mode is 0, its priority at +0x39, then marks the channel block dirty with bit 0x20000 using the second channel table.
evidence: Uses selector 0x131E / pointers +0x10B4 table; caller Snd_UpdateChannelState; field semantics inferred.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelWord34
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelWord34(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, unsigned int value)
summary: Stores a caller-supplied 32-bit word at +0x34 of the channel block and marks it dirty with bit 0x40000.
evidence: Offset +0x34, dirty bit 0x40000, caller supplies value; meaning of word unproven.

name: Snd_SetChannelWaveData
signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelWaveData(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, unsigned int* data)
summary: Copies a 0x20-byte buffer descriptor into the channel's wave slot (table at +0x1234 selected by the +0x1322 double-buffer index) and sets dirty bit 4.
evidence: Source table +0x1234 matches the buffer layout used by SetupChannelBuffers; 0x20-byte copy matches per-buffer descriptor size; single named caller Snd_UpdateChannelState.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelWord3A
signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelWord3A(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, unsigned short value)
summary: Stores a 16-bit value at +0x3A of the channel block and marks it dirty with bit 0x400000.
evidence: Only the offset, width and dirty bit are hard facts; the sole caller Snd_UpdateChannelState passes a computed value with no field meaning attached.

name: Snd_SetChannelLoopPoints
signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelLoopPoints(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, unsigned short start, unsigned short end)
summary: Writes a byte at +0xF and a halfword at +0x3E of the channel block and marks it dirty with bit 0x800000, consistent with a loop start/end pair.
evidence: Paired position write (byte + halfword) with one dirty bit; single caller Snd_UpdateChannelState supplies both values; offsets are the only hard evidence.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelAdpcmParams
signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelAdpcmParams(SndMixer* mixer, int channel, unsigned short arg3, unsigned short b, unsigned short c, unsigned short d, unsigned short e)
summary: Writes five consecutive fields of the channel block (+0x40, +0x42, +0x44, +0x46 and byte +0x45) and marks it dirty with bit 0x1000000, the shape of a decoder parameter block.
evidence: Five consecutive 16-bit fields written together; ADPCM state fields at +0x24/+0x26 support the decoder-parameter reading; only offsets are hard evidence.

name: Os_RefreshCachedHandle
summary: Queries the fixed IPC session (command 0x0C) for a new handle, closes the handle currently stored in *handleOut with svc 0x23, and stores the queried value there.
evidence: Callee Os_IpcQueryCommand0C writes the reply word to *out; body closes *handleOut via svc 0x23 before overwriting; no timer/counter read anywhere.

name: maybe_Video_IdctSubblocks
summary: Runs Video_IdctBlock4x4 once for each set bit (1, 2, 4, 8) of the current sub-block mask byte, reconstructing up to four 4x4 sub-blocks; mid-function entry.
evidence: Callee Video_IdctBlock4x4 is named and the four guarded calls line up with the four mask bits; unaff_r6 indicates damaged decompilation and no callers.

name: maybe_Video_IdctSubblocks_B
summary: Second copy of the per-mask 4x4 inverse-transform loop, running Video_IdctBlock4x4_B once for each set bit of the sub-block mask byte; template copy of 0x001356D4.
evidence: Identical decompiled body to 0x001356D4 differing only in IDCT callee and constant table address; no caller and unaff_r6 (damaged decompilation).

name: maybe_Video_IdctSubblocks_C
summary: Sub-block 4x4 inverse transform loop in track C: reads the sub-block mask byte at 0x08010400[unaff_r6] and calls Video_IdctBlock4x4_C once for each set bit.
evidence: Aligned with confirmed twins 0x001356D4 and 0x0013BCD4; callee Video_IdctBlock4x4_C is a confirmed 4x4 IDCT; damaged decompilation with unaff_r6.

name: maybe_SQCommand_Tail
summary: Mid-function split of SQCommand (0x0015179C); the listed callees belong to the enclosing routine, not to a stand-alone function.
evidence: DOC states SQCommand at 0x0015179C is a seed symbol whose 2744-byte range contains this address; no callers; body is a truncated tail calling func_001902B4 and Text_Page_BuildAtOffset.

name: maybe_Gfx_MovieFrame_BuildEntry
signature: u32 maybe_Gfx_MovieFrame_BuildEntry(void* queue, u32 surface, u32 arg3)
summary: Fills two six-word arrays in the movie queue's f_0 sub-structure and advances a wrapping slot index; called by Gfx_MovieQueue_Push for each decoded movie surface.
evidence: DOC: intact ARM push {r4-r8,lr} body with six-iteration loop and mla scale; only real caller is named Gfx_MovieQueue_Push; Ghidra halt_baddata is wrong.

name: maybe_MessageRegistActor_Continuation
summary: Continuation block of MessageRegistActor (0x00159B7C) that calls Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotSprite on ctx->f_8->f_48; not a stand-alone entry point.
evidence: No caller and no prologue; 0x00159B7C MessageRegistActor is the only user; body loads ctx+8 then +0x48 before the call.

name: maybe_Script_ReturnZeroStub2
summary: Placeholder script native that performs VM stack-slot bookkeeping via Script_SetSlotFromStackAlt and returns 0; no caller and no distinguishing behaviour.
evidence: Only callee is Script_SetSlotFromStackAlt; 16-byte body; no callers; no strings or constants.

name: maybe_Battle_CommandSlots_TryDecrement
summary: Tentatively decrements the third byte of each of four 3-byte command slots whose id is 5, validates with Battle_CheckUnitCommandCondition(self,5), and restores all four values when the condition fails.
evidence: Slot offsets +0xFD/+0x100/+0x103/+0x106 and the validation call match Battle_CheckUnitCommandCondition (0x001745E8) exactly; no callers.

name: maybe_Container_AddInstanceWithHandle
summary: Inserts an instance into a container table when enabled (f_e0==1) or kind<5: reserves a free slot, stores a generation-wrapped handle from f_e4, then registers via 0x0017C9F8.
evidence: Body shows free-slot request, generation-counter bump with wrap against *(u32*)0x007A8B40+4, and registration call 0x0017C9F8; only caller is unnamed 0x005F4D40.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Refresh
summary: Lightweight per-frame refresh of a field scene object: advances animation, re-applies actor movement state from +0x246, and resets animation when flags at +0x29F and +0xB8 are set.
evidence: No caller; named callees Field_SceneObject_ResetAnimation and maybe_Actor_SelectAnimEntry0 fit a refresh but do not pin down phase or gating flag.

name: maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanA
signature: void maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanA(void* self, const TextEntry* entry, u32 word0, u32 word1)
summary: Text-layout span builder with push {r4-r8,lr} prologue and style<7/non-empty-span guard; Ghidra truncates after the first call so only the shape is known.
evidence: Disassembly starts with ARM push and style/span guard, but readable C is a single mis-marked wcslen call (damaged decompilation); twin at 0x0018D24C; caller maybe_Text_DecodeName.

name: maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanB

summary: Truncated Thumb routine whose only recovered action is a call to Ui_Balloon_UpdateAnchorPosition and return 0; what it refreshes is unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_ResourceSetOwner_Dtor
summary: Destructor thunk for a UI object embedding a Ui_ResourceSet at +0x38: installs the class vtable, runs Ui_ResourceSet_Dtor on the embedded bundle and returns the adjusted base pointer.

name: maybe_Ui_State_SetState2
summary: Initialises a transition record with 0xFF/0xFFFF invalid defaults, notifies the active screen via manager vtable +0x5C, sets screen command 2 and copies the handler pair from the item-screen callback table.
evidence: Callers are shop/item window state machine functions; body only restates command constant 2 and copies from g_uiItemScreenSelectCallbacks; owner of the record still unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_State_HandleEvent
summary: One step of a window state machine: pulls the current input event, forwards x/y/z to the child at screen+0x184 via vtable +0x3C, and on event bit 0x102 dispatches to the step-1/step-2/step-0x18 helpers, storing the next handler pair.
evidence: No callers; callees include shop item list confirm, text scroll end, shop sell and the SetState helpers; vtable constant shared with named Ui_Window_OnActiveStateChanged / Ui_ShopWindow_Ctor code.
